messages:
laura: Quick sync — small but important question about merging docs PR #789. If we merge into main before the 'lightswitch' feature flag flips, will the public preview show the v2 SDK snippets or fallback to v1? I'm planning a merge window tomorrow 09:30 PT, want to avoid broken examples. cc @matt @hema

matt: Preview builds from main, so if the runtime behavior depends on the flag the examples might still render v1 flows. The docs site does support versioned routes (e.g., /v2/) but that won't auto-switch examples unless we gate them.

hema: For gating we can add frontmatter: `version: next` and `feature_flag: lightswitch`. That way the site will mark the snippet as gated. Caveat: our snippet test harness currently fails if fence languages change (js vs ts).

laura: Gotcha. CI preview for #789 already reported a snippet linter complaint: see log below. I'll paste the relevant bit.

ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #789 — snippet-check error:
```
[ERROR] snippet-check: mismatch detected
file: docs/sdk/js/usage.md
line: 42
expected fence: js
found fence: ts
exit code: 1
```

alex: I can patch the snippet to be language-agnostic (or provide both fences). My suggested order: 1) push snippet-fix PR, 2) merge snippet PR, 3) merge docs PR into staging so preview includes fix, 4) QA canary, 5) flip lightswitch at release window (11:00 PT). Thoughts?

jordan: Can we use the canary preview param first? QA typically reviews with `?canary=true` to validate runtime-dependent snippets without flipping prod flag. If we skip canary we might ship a regression.

laura: Proposed timeline: 09:00 PT — push snippet-fix PR (reviewers: @alex, @matt). 09:30 PT — merge docs PR into staging (docs preview will create a canary snapshot). 10:30 PT — QA thumbs up on canary. 11:00 PT — lightswitch flip in release window. Please call out blockers now.

matt: I can review the snippet PR at 08:45 PT. Hema — can you run the snippet check locally? Command: `./scripts/snippet-check --path docs/sdk/js --commit $SHA` and paste failing fences if any.

hema: Running now. If the linter still trips I'll post exact lines. Also note: we need a redirect for old links — `/docs/sdk` -> `/docs/sdk/v2/` (301) otherwise some customers hitting saved links will break. Laura, can you add a redirect note to the PR description?

laura: Done — added "redirect note: add 301 rule for /docs/sdk -> /docs/sdk/v2/" to PR description. Also adding `changelog: docs` and `release: minor` frontmatter as discussed.

alex: I'll prepare the snippet fix, include both fences + a short comment block showing the expected output. I'll tag the PR `needs-qa` and schedule merge for 09:30. Also proposing a soft merge freeze 11:00–12:00 during lightswitch flip — small typo fixes allowed but no structural changes.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs-preview links expire after 8h. Use `?live=true` for persistent snapshots. See https://docs.example.com/preview-help

ci-bot: Re-run queued preview for #789: https://ci.example.com/builds/5678 (queued). Will post status when complete.

laura: Thanks — I'll wait for the snippet PR to land and then push the gated frontmatter into the docs PR. Ping me in this thread when CI is green and QA has checked canary. :thumbsup:
